scope: Independent read-only security, contract-consistency and final-gate review of the HRM-013 owner/runtime binding preparation carrier, validator and standard contract-check registration. No backend implementation, migration, worktree, runtime binding or activation was reviewed or authorized.

reviewLanes.coverage: Proof carriers, exact workload identities, drain authority, 30-second authorization and 65-second quiet-window races, Auth-local roles, three-member waiver dependency closure, successor carrier immutability, command grammar, canonical paths, Git modes and symlink rejection.

Lineage and repository pins, phase ordering, source and test allowlists, V59-to-Auth projection mapping, service-binding v2-to-v3 append, all eight canonical 24-column rows, twelve acceptance conditions and zero implementation authority.
Gate, validator and package bytes; carrier and successor direct-child lifecycle; immutable historical artifacts; exact closed pin sets; register and command semantic consistency.

finalVerdict.reason: All reported authority, rotation, projection, register, command-grammar, path-integrity and evidence-pin defects are closed on the pinned bytes. Runtime implementation remains deliberately unauthorized.

closed: Separated root delivery, dependent read and deterministic terminal-child drain continuations and bound their seven conditional claims.
Added role-specific append-only drain activity revisions, 30-second authorization expiry, 65-second post-activity quiet observation and stale-readiness invalidation.
Specified the three Auth-local role operations without self-HTTP and bound the HRM-013 requester lookup to the APR-002 root.
Expanded APR-002, HRM-010 and SVC-AUT-HRM-013 into one atomic waiver dependency group for ADMIT, QUIESCING, readiness, CUTOVER, ABORT and emergency REVOKE.
Required all six role receipts and the named waiver-group rotation test.
Made the original gate, validator and independent review immutable against their carrier-commit blobs in historical mode.
Required the successor authority, validator, review and v3 register to be Git-tracked regular files introduced by one exact direct-child commit.
Pinned predecessor and successor artifacts and rejected ignored-file, arbitrary-command, shell-masking and duplicate-command bypasses.
Enforced canonical POSIX paths, HRIS-root containment, global command uniqueness, safe Git modes, invocation-root identity and cumulative-component symlink rejection.
Defined the exact APR-002 and HRM-010 V59-to-Auth comparison maps and separated local-only from Auth-only integrity fields and digests.
Kept SVC-AUT-HRM-013 Auth-only and added named projection and waiver rotation test coverage.
Bound the mandatory service-binding v3 register to the same reviewed successor carrier before shared source authority can open.
Pinned the v2 register bytes and required a byte-preserving append of exactly eight ordered bindings.
Sealed all 24 CSV columns through deterministic common, profile and row maps plus ordered-row SHA-256 720ac954b8f5f45b520900a1e078bc1cb5b5750dc79745f714fb994dab9765ea.

Aligned resolver traffic to the sole X-DWP-Workload-Proof carrier with a leaf-certificate-signed resolver profile and aligned task replay evidence to payloadSha256, requestBodySha256 and receiptSha256.
Required exact cardinality, path uniqueness and exact-map equality for the initial review pins, successor predecessor pins and successor review pins.
Re-ran all three independent lanes against one stable gate, validator and package hash set with no further findings.

nonClaims: This review does not authorize shared-contract, Auth, Approval, People, task-owner or Performance source implementation.

This review does not authorize a worktree, runtime credential, tenant enrollment, feature enablement, controller or relay activation, production binding or release.
This review grants no HRM-013, Batch-06 or HRIS business-completion credit.
